༄༅༅/ /rab tu spros pa med pa'i dbang mchog byin rlabs chu bo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅༅/ /rab tu spros pa med pa'i dbang mchog byin rlabs

chu bo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / dpal ldan tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i gtso/ /kun bzang chos rje bla ma la/ /dad brgya'i spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ /rab tu spros med dbang chog bri/ /de la shin tu dben pa'i gnas bla gab med par/ /lnga tshan lnga'i maṇḍal tshogs dang gtor mas brgyan pa sta gon byas la/ nyi ma ri bo'i rtser shar ba'i dus su cho ga dngos bya ba'i rim pa la bzhi ste/ 'jug pa/ dbang*/ ngo sprod/ gzengs bstod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bla mas bu khyod su yin/ zhes lan gsum dris pa'i lan du/ slob mas/ skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po lags/ zhes pa gsum brjod pa dang*/ bla mas/ de ltar yin phan chad sems nyid gdod ma nas skye ma myong ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du zhugs shing ces brjod pa dang*/ slob mas thal mo sbyar te/ kye bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /bdag la rab tu dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni khams gsum 'khor gnas su/ /yun ring gnas pa dran nyams te/ /'khor ba nyid las brgal don du/ /bla ma la yang zhu bar bgyid/ /bskal pa brgya phrag du mar ni/ /bdag ni yang nas yang 'khor bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes rang byung nyid/ /smad dang rtsa ba bcas pa'i sangs rgyas sems las byung*/ /sems kyi dam pa bdag la bstan du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ bla ma'i thugs kar ce re bltar bcug pa'i mtshams su/ bla mas/ sems gang yin zhes drag shul can gsum dris pas/ brjod ma shes pa'i rig pa stong pa ni/ ye shes dbab pa'o/ / gnyis pa dbang la gsum las/ sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dbang ni/ slob ma rnams seng ge'i lta stangs bstun la shar phyogs su bltas te/ tshig phyir sems gzhol bas bsam du gzhug cing*/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon cig /shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams shin tu mdzes shing nyams dga' ba yid du 'ong ba na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa zhes bya ba/

sku mdog dkar po rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis su med pa 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed gcig bzhugs shing*/ rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan zhing rang rang gi nye 'khor la chos ston pa dang*/ rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to/ /bu khyod der glang po che'i lta stangs kyis ltos la/ seng ge'i mchongs stangs kyis mchongs shig /a a a/ zhes brjod/ yang slob ma rnams lhor bltas la/ glang po che'i 'dug stangs bstun te/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon cig /lho phyogs na dpal dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams shin tu mdzes shing nyams dga' ba yid du 'ong ba na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyan rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya ba/ sku mdog ser po rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis su med pa/ 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing*/ rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan zhing*/ rang rang gi nye 'khor la chos ston pa/ rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to/ /bu khyod seng ge'i lta stangs kyis ltos la/ stag mo'i mchongs stangs kyis mchongs shig /a a a/ zhes brjod nas/ nub tu bltas te drang srong gi 'dug stangs bstun pa la/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon cig /nub phyogs na padma brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams shin tu mdzes shing nyams dga' ba yid du 'ong ba na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas zhes bya ba/ sku mdog dmar po rin po che'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ yab yum gnyis su med pa/ 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing*/ rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan zhing*/ rang rang gi nye 'khor la chos ston pa/

rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba gsang sngags kyi de kho nyid ston to/ /bu khyod dpal chen gyi rngam stabs kyis ltos la/ khyung nam mkha' la lding ba'i 'gros kyis song zhig /a a a/ zhes pa gsum brjod nas/ byang du bltas te/ tsog pu las lag sor 'jug rdor bsgongs pa bya rgod kyi spungs stangs kyis 'dug pa la/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon cig /byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams shin tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba na/ yang dag par rdzogs sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba sku mdog ljang gu rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis su med pa/ 'khor rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing*/ rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan zhing*/ rang rang gi nye 'khor la chos ston pa/ rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to/ /bu khyod der rdo rje 'chang gi lta stangs kyis ltos la/ glog dmar gyi 'khyug stangs kyis song zhig /a a a/ zhes brjod do/ / de dag ni sprul pa'i skur grol bar byed pa'i dbang ngo*/ /longs sku'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug par byed pa'i dbang ni/ slob ma rdo rje'i skyil krung gis 'dug pa la/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po rnams nyon cig /de dag thams cad las 'das pa'i pha rol na/ rgyan yongs su bkod pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams/ ye shes lngas khyab cing gsal ba/ bar du mnyam nyid mi g.yo ba nyid na/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ dgra bcom pa*/ zag pa zad pa/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas brgya stong bye ba mang pos bskor ba/ sems nyid mngon par 'dus ma byas pa la rol pa zhig yod kyis/

bu khyod der glang po che'i lta stangs kyis ltos la/ seng ge'i mchongs stangs kyis song zhig /a a a/ zhes brjod do/ /chos sku'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dbang ni/ slob ma rnams seng ge'i 'dug stangs bstun pa la/ bla mas/ e ma/ skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po rnams nyon cig /de las kyang 'das pa'i pha rol na/ rang gi sems nyid bsam ngo dang bral zhing*/ tshad med dpag tu med cing dmigs su med pa/ stong nyid gang du'ang ma phye ba'i chos nyid ces bya ba bzhugs pas/ der bu khyod khyung nam mkhar lding ba'i 'gros kyis mtho sar 'dug cig /drang srong gi lta stangs kyis gnas par gyis shig /glang chen gyi nyal stabs kyis snyom par nyol zhig /lcags sdong gi 'dril stangs kyis kha sbub la mtha' dril zhig /skyes bu'i rgyangs thabs kyis gan rkyal du rgyongs shig /wa mo'i zur 'gros kyis slog la song zhig /bya rgod kyi spungs stangs kyis bsgyur bzlog gis spungs shig /gyad kyi dor stabs kyis ngal bsos la sa non zhig /'bu srin gyi nur 'gros kyis dbyings rig ma chags par gyis shig /stag mo'i mchongs stangs kyis nyams snang la rtsal sbyongs shig /g.yang mo'i sprugs stangs kyis gzung 'dzin gyi bag chags thams cad dus gcig la ngo bor sprugs shig /seng ge'i 'gying tshul gyis dbyings rig la sa zung zhig /e ma skal ldan sems gyi bu gcig /sems nyid stong par gnas pas gzhi zung zhig /sems nyid rig stong du gnas pas gnad tshud cig /sems ma 'gag par 'gyur bas rtsal sbyongs shig /sems nyid ye shes su gsal bas lam sbyongs shig /sems nyid kun la khyab pas rtags tshol zhig /sems nyid cig char du myur bas la zlos shig /sems nyid sna tshogs ma 'dres par shan phyes shig /sems nyid sna tshogs par 'phel bas ma zhen cig /ye shes las slar ma ldog cig /sku las slar ma ldog cig /thig le las slar ma ldog cig

/ces brjod la de dag gi don bshad de/ de ltar gsum yang gzhi snang dang gzhi'i dbang ste/ 'di dang bar do rang bzhin sprul pa sku gsum gang rung du grol bar byed pa'i dbang ngo*/ / gsum pa ngo sprad pa ni/ brjod pa dang po sprul sku/ gnyis pa longs sku/ gsum pa chos sku'i lta stangs bstun du bcug la/ bla mas/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po rnams/ sems nyid ngo bo stong la rang bzhin ye shes lhag mthong gi don nyon cig /sems nyid bde stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i gzhi ye shes lngar bsgyur zhig /sems nyid bde stong ye shes zang thal gyis ma rig pa sol cig /sems nyid blo rim du 'jug pa'i theg pa tha dad kyi mtha' thig le nyag gcig tu bsdus shig /sems nyid stong pa mtha' bral thig le yongs rdzogs la chos kyi phugs gtod cig /sems nyid zung 'jug rang snang lhug pas don gyi gnad khrol zhig /sems dbyings rig rnam dag smin mtshams 'od gsal la rlung rig gcud la bor zhig /gang zhe na/ mgrin pa an tsam dgug /mig gyen la log /rlung rang sor bcad/ lag pa g.yas pas mig mnan/ mig g.yon pa nam mkhar bltas pas ye shes kyi snang ba 'phel lo/ /sems nyid chos sku ma bcos rang byung rnal ma la/ phyi nang gcig tu gzhi phob cig /sems nyid ma 'dres yongs rdzogs nyag gcig phyogs bral las slar ma ldog cig /sprul skur song zhig /longs skur song zhig /chos skur song zhig /chos sku la ma 'dzin slar ma ldog cig /longs sku la ma 'dzin slar ma ldog cig /sprul sku la ma 'dzin slar ma ldog cig /ces pa gsum brjod dus/ bar pa la mgrin pa drang thad la bzhag /mig cung zad dbab ces go brje'o/ /tha ma mgrin pa bstod/ mig gyen la blta/ zhes go brje'o/ /mig kyang skyes pa la g.yas/ bud med la g.yon du brjod par bya'o/ / bzhi pa gzengs bstod pa ni/ dbang 'di thob nas rig pa ye shes kyi rang gdangs zhi ba longs sku'i zhing la spyod par dbang*/

ma rig pa gzhi la sangs nas sgo gsum 'ching ba'i rgya las grol ba thob/ ye shes lhun grub gyi gzhi snang ka dag tu thim nas nang dbyings lhun grub kyi ye shes la spyod/ 'bad na tshe 'dir grol zhing*/ ma 'bad kyang bar do'am rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing du sangs rgya'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas tshogs kyi dga' ba dang*/ rdo rje'i glu bkra shis kyi bar du bya'o/ /dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba kun/ /dbang mchog rgyal po'i sa thob shog /bkra shis dge legs phun tshogs kyis/ / rtag tu bkra shis byed par shog /rab tu spros pa med pa'i dbang chog byin rlabs chu bo zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ me tog brtsegs pa'i skyed mos tshal du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (11)rab tu spros pa med pa'i dbang mchog byin rlabs chu bo/ -PAGE 104- -PAGE 105--PAGE 102-
